- Avoids Round-2 error **D** (using late/settlement pages to infer earlier actions): we start with entrance routing, not end artifacts.

- Avoids Round-2 error **A** (one “eye-catching” hanger page representing all): p.3 prevents silent missing resources.

- Avoids Round-2 error **E** (merge by noun/diagram): p.4 anchors the actual port universe before any “DP/HDMI/power” pages are interpreted.
